why_build: A current close structural reference and the broader case-opening reward grammar provide enough market evidence to justify a cheap real probe, while the frozen one-screen scope remains within the portfolio production envelope.
top_supporting_evidence: listing 533677: 867 ratingCount at ~71.8 days, nine exact-query exposures across six families, best observed rank 2, compact four-box/random-rarity/collection loop
case-opening family: 48 observed members, median ratingCount 6609, p75 22454.75, all-query Jaccard 0.5, supporting anticipation+rarity reward strength
candidate avoids the 3D/meta/backend burden present in many high-traction benchmark games
top_counter_evidence: multiple near-minimal pack-opening/reskin games in the same sweep have weak or zero ratingCount traction
generic real-object case simulators are weak long-run references despite larger content/meta burden
search exposure/rank does not imply demand: listing 550787 had 14 exact-query exposures and best rank 1 but ratingCount 0 at ~42 days
working Pocket Gremlins theme is original and production-friendly but not independently market-validated
unknowns: competitor ad revenue and monetization efficiency
historical trajectory before the current sweep
